```yaml
name: Build Universal macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          architecture: 'universal'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install setuptools wheel twine

      - name: Import codesign certificates
        uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v2
        with:
          p12-filepath: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERT_P12 }}
          p12-password: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERT_PASSWORD }}

  build:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          architecture: 'universal'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install setuptools wheel twine

      - name: Build universal binary
        run: |
          python setup.py bdist_dmg --plat-name=macosx_10_15_x86_64_arm64

      - name: Sign DMG
        run: |
          codesign --deep --force --sign "Developer ID Application: Your Name" dist/mfat-sssh pilot.app

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: mfat-sssh.dmg
          path: dist/mfat-sssh.dmg
```

Please note that you need to replace `Your Name` with your actual developer name and set the `MACOS_CERT_P12` and `MACOS_CERT_PASSWORD` secrets in your repository settings. Additionally, ensure that your `setup.py` script is configured to handle universal builds.
